title: The 'Alien Signal' That Was a Message from Our Future Selves
hook: A signal detected from deep space wasn't from aliens—it was Earth, billions of years in the future, sending a warning back in time.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time travel + aliens + existential dread is a perfect viral cocktail, especially with a 'we are the aliens' twist.

title: The Hidden 'Kill Switch' Inside Every Black Hole
hook: Every black hole in the universe contains a singularity that, if activated, would erase the entire galaxy instantly—and we don't know who built it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a built-in 'off switch' for reality is terrifying and mysterious, tapping into conspiracy and cosmic horror.

title: The Classified 'Planet Killer' Telescope That Saw Too Much
hook: A telescope built in the 1990s detected an asteroid heading straight for Earth—then the government classified the images and never launched a mission.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy + real danger = irresistible hook. Viewers love 'what did the government hide?' narratives.

title: The Extinction That Happened When the Sun Went 'Dark' for a Year
hook: 1,200 years ago, the sun dimmed so much that crops failed across the entire planet—and we still don't know what caused it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Historical mystery + global disaster + unsolved science = high curiosity and shareability.

title: The 'Death Star' Pulsar That's Aimed Directly at Earth
hook: A rapidly spinning neutron star is firing a beam of radiation that sweeps across Earth every 1.3 seconds—and one day, it might not miss.
why_this_can_go_viral: Comparing a real pulsar to the Death Star is clickable, and the 'aimed at Earth' angle adds real fear.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: 'We're in a Cosmic Prison'
hook: A physicist proposed that advanced civilizations don't expand because they're trapped in their own solar systems—by something that doesn't want them to leave.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'prison planet' theory is one of the most viral Fermi paradox explanations, blending sci-fi with real physics.

title: The Classified 'Solar Shield' That Protects Only the Rich
hook: A secret space-based shield was designed to deflect solar flares—but it only covers a few square miles, and you need to know the right people.
why_this_can_go_viral: Class warfare + space technology + secrecy = viral outrage and curiosity.

title: The Asteroid That Deliberately Avoided Earth—Then Came Back
hook: An asteroid changed course to miss Earth, looped around the sun, and returned on a collision path—as if it was targeting us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphizing an asteroid as 'targeting' Earth creates a terrifying narrative that screams 'share me.'

title: The 'Ghost Galaxy' That Absorbed Its Own Suns
hook: A galaxy with no visible stars exists—its suns were all pulled into a central void, leaving only a dark silhouette in space.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'ghost galaxy' is inherently viral, and the idea of a starless galaxy is haunting.

title: The 'Planet Nine' That's Actually a Primordial Black Hole
hook: The mysterious gravitational pull in the outer solar system isn't a planet—it's a black hole the size of a grapefruit, and it's closer than you think.
why_this_can_go_viral: Black holes in our backyard is terrifying and exciting. The 'grapefruit-sized' detail makes it tangible.

title: The Extinction That Was a 'Silent Comet'—No Tail, No Warning
hook: A comet with no visible tail or glow struck Earth during the ice age—we only found out because of a layer of iridium, buried in ice.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an invisible killer from space is deeply unsettling and counters the 'we'd see it coming' assumption.

title: The Star That Explodes Every 80 Years—And We're Due
hook: A star system 3,000 light-years away erupts like clockwork—the last eruption was in 1946, and the next is overdue right now.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'overdue' countdown creates urgency and fear, perfect for short-form video pacing.

title: The 'Dark Matter Pathogen' That Infects All Living Cells
hook: A controversial theory suggests dark matter interacts with biology—and it might be mutating DNA across the universe, including ours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Linking dark matter to human biology and disease is a fresh, scary angle that feels like a sci-fi thriller.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: 'We're in a Simulation With a Bug'
hook: The reason we see no aliens isn't because they don't exist—it's because the simulation we live in hasn't rendered them yet, and the silence is a glitch.
why_this_can_go_viral: Simulation theory is massively viral, and adding a 'bug' twist is fresh and shareable.

title: The Signal That Warped Space Time as It Traveled
hook: A signal detected by LIGO wasn't a gravitational wave—it was a radio signal so powerful it bent spacetime around it, and we have no idea what sent it.
why_this_can_go_viral: A signal that bends reality is a concept that breaks the brain, making it highly clickable.

title: The Classified 'Moon Mine' That Extracted Helium-3 in Secret
hook: Declassified documents reveal a secret lunar mining operation that extracted Helium-3—but the real payload was something else, buried beneath the surface.
why_this_can_go_viral: Secret moon bases and hidden resources are perennial viral topics, especially with a 'what else was there?' twist.

title: The 'Rogue Sun' That Will Pass Through the Oort Cloud—Soon
hook: A star is barreling toward our solar system at 800,000 mph—it will pass through the Oort Cloud in 1.5 million years, sending comets toward Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: A 'long-term countdown' to disaster creates dread, and the 'barreling toward us' language is gripping.

title: The 'Vacuum Bubble' That Already Erased a Galaxy
hook: Astronomers found a region of space where no galaxies exist—and the border is expanding. It's the edge of a vacuum decay bubble that's eating the universe.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vacuum decay is the ultimate existential threat—'the universe is dissolving' is a guaranteed viral hook.

title: The 'Zombie Comet' That Refuses to Die After 20 Passes
hook: A comet that should have disintegrated after passing the sun keeps coming back—and each time, it's larger, as if something is rebuilding it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'zombie' framing is clickable, and the mystery of a comet that grows instead of shrinks is intriguing.

title: The Extinction That Was a 'Solar Flare' That Hit Earth's Magnetic Weak Spot
hook: The Carrington Event of 1859 almost wiped out civilization—but a flare 100x stronger hit the same weak spot in our magnetic field 10,000 years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: Comparing a historical near-miss to a prehistoric extinction makes the threat feel immediate and real.

title: The 'Magnetic Star' That Can Wipe All Electronics on Earth
hook: A magnetar 15,000 light-years away is so magnetic that if it erupted, it could wipe every circuit on Earth—and we'd have zero warning.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'EMP from space' scenario is a modern fear that resonates with tech-dependent audiences.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: 'We're in a Cosmic Slow Zone'
hook: A physicist argues that the speed of light isn't a law—it's a local speed limit enforced by a field that surrounds our solar system, trapping us inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that physics is locally manipulated is mind-bending and feels like a twist from a sci-fi blockbuster.

title: The Signal That Was a 'Galactic Census'—And Earth Was Listed
hook: A signal from deep space contained a list of 4,000 star systems—including Sol. Someone is counting civilizations, and we're on their list.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'we're being tracked' narrative is deeply unsettling and taps into surveillance fears on a cosmic scale.
